environment: isolated local Supabase/PostgreSQL + Next dev + native Chromium persistent on-disk profile

cases.title: 真实非空提交丢响应后关闭整个浏览器重开，fresh 权限与 actor 隔离后只读确认原回执
请求未发送时重开只报 missing，不把当前相似数据当提交成功或重写
原提交之后另一管理员真实保存，重开显示 superseded 且不覆盖后续统计
编辑后另一 tab 切换 actor，旧 command 真实请求被拒绝而不以新 actor 提交

faultBoundary.browser: Actual HTTP Server Action executed via Playwright route.fetch, response discarded with route.abort after the server completed; missing case aborts before forwarding. Persistent Chromium process is closed and relaunched from the same profile.
faultBoundary.postgresAdapter: Separate PG test executes a real COMMIT, then a test adapter throws to simulate a lost acknowledgement; this is not an actual PG-wire disconnect.

scope: Functional recovery evidence; no production latency, LCP, provider/model accuracy or mobile claim.

postgresEvidence.nonemptySave: Real stats row write; actor-change denial; same-operation concurrent replay creates one audit/receipt; competing nonempty save CAS admits one; old-operation replay leaves superseding stats untouched.
